cookie_requirements: opaque random session ID only; server stores the hash
protections: unsafe requests require exact Origin, synchronizer CSRF token, JSON content type, and Fetch Metadata validation
event cursors are opaque and never carry a bearer or capability
logout and revocation invalidate all outstanding ops sessions and capabilities

classifications.O0_ops_safe: health state, safe request lifecycle, safe release note, and safe labels
classifications.O1_restricted_operations: redacted diagnostics, correlation IDs, configuration fingerprints, and scoped evidence
classifications.O2_business_link_only: authorized business reference and safe label only; details stay in Workspace
classifications.O3_security_restricted: access and audit detail, grant metadata, and secret metadata
classifications.O4_never_store: secret values, DSNs, tokens, cookies, authorization headers, raw OAuth claims, raw transcripts, raw client payloads, arbitrary terminal output, and untrusted prompt text as instruction

redaction_rules: Redact before persistence, display, export, model context, and telemetry.
Every evidence item declares its redaction profile and withheld paths.
SecretReference stores provider, location, version, owner, rotation, and test metadata only.
Logs, documents, issue text, and business content are untrusted data and cannot alter capability, target, plan, tool choice, or approval.
Unauthorized object lookup returns not_found unless the caller already has authorized existence context.

proven: every nested fixture object is closed by additionalProperties false
undeclared nested fields fail synthetic pre-persistence fixture validation
prototype presentation models are serialized only through contract-declared fields
secret-shaped values in declared strings are redacted
prototype telemetry is a closed seven-field projection
phase0_executable_boundary.future_gate: No implementation may claim redaction complete until a single injected canary is absent from storage, typed API responses, audit exports, model packets, rendered DOM, and the telemetry sink.

freshness.healthy_only_when: Every required authoritative signal for the displayed target is successful, in scope, and fresh before valid_until.
unknown_when: required collector is offline or unauthenticated
required collector is unavailable or stale
sample covers another resource or environment
forbidden: cached Healthy without a fresh source
inferring Healthy from lack of error
planned Staging as Empty or Healthy
freshness.offline: Cached views are read-only and visibly timestamped. Offline approval, action, grant, repair, and automation change do not exist.

retention.redacted_execution_evidence: 90 days hot, then purge unless under incident, release, or audit hold
retention.implementation_gate: No deletion automation ships until Joe accepts durations and legal-hold ownership.
